task.title: Extract all system pages and UI components for the new design system
task.objective: Produce a complete, structured extraction of every renderer page (route/screen), every exported UI component, the current Hologram design-token vocabulary and the non-negotiable constraints, so an external design pass (Claude Design) can map a new UI design system onto the existing class hooks and tokens without guessing at the surface area. Documentation only: no renderer, CSS, main-process or runtime code is modified.

routing.expected_paths_note: The last two are SYSTEM_BOOKKEEPING_PATHS (tools/agents/lease.mjs): grantLease writes the lease file and mirrors the holder into assignments.json. They are tool-written byproducts of taking the lease, not hand-edited progress numbers, and they stay out of writer.allowed_paths so the writer still cannot touch them directly.

architecture: Documentation only. No renderer, main-process, preload, runner or CSS source file is edited by this task.
The extraction records the CURRENT surface; it does not propose or apply a redesign.
security: No secrets, credentials, tokens, machine identifiers or license material are copied into the extraction.
Protected-login handoff behaviour is described only as an existing UI contract, never as an automation recipe.
compatibility: Class hooks, token names and the window.playwrightFlowStudio preload identifier are recorded verbatim so a redesign can target them without renaming.
offline: The extraction documents the offline-first constraints (no CDN fonts, no remote assets, no runtime network) that any new design system must respect.

acceptance.description: Every renderer route in app/renderer/routes.tsx is present in the extraction with its id, label, description, icon, navigation group, permission gate, layout family and root CSS class; non-route surfaces (login/security screens, modals, Settings sub-panels) are recorded separately.

Every exported UI component under app/renderer/components/**, app/renderer/layout/**, app/renderer/security/**, app/renderer/semantic/** and app/renderer/pages/admin/components/** is present with its source path, exported name, props and CSS class hooks.

The design-token contract is recorded: primitives, light theme, dark theme, connector and gradient-accent tokens from app/renderer/styles/global.css, plus the runtime accent override contract in src/theme/accentColor.ts.

The hard constraints a redesign must respect (token-only styling, no parallel class systems, offline asset rules, preload identifier, shell grid permission rule, accessibility and reduced-motion requirements) are stated explicitly in the extraction index.
git status shows no modification to any file outside the writer's allowed paths; no application source or stylesheet is touched.

evidence.notes: Six documents written and cross-checked against source at 28fb9fb: README.md (index, 12 hard constraints, source map), 01-app-shell.md (shell DOM, height budget, AppFrame/WindowControls/LeftNavigation/TopHeader/StatusBar/DesignerCanvasLayout/AppShell, theming pipeline), 02-design-tokens.md (~226 --awkit-* tokens, light/dark/connector/gradient-accent, accentColor.ts override contract, stylesheet region map), 03-pages.md (all 33 routes across seven layout families plus non-route surfaces), 04-components.md (98 exported components across 14 directories with paths, props and class hooks), 05-patterns.md (seven state patterns, motion spine, accessibility contracts, icon system, density constants, redesign checklist). Every fact was read from source; no application source or stylesheet was modified.

completion.qa_note: risk_level 0 routed no qa reviewer and no qc reviewer, so no separate QA agent ran. The PASS records the verification that was actually performed: ev-inspection, a source-verified read of all six documents against app/renderer at 28fb9fb. There is no build, runner or GUI evidence for this task because it changes no executable code.
